note: Spec 014 T078 follow-up (T081: go_deeper takes any hand-in-ready skill tagged on a step of the latest answer, because turn 4 may offer to go deeper on the step that didn't land). Whether the first answer offered the pivot isn't forced: Set the pivot is a tagged step either way, so the case pins that the yes works from turn 4 and that no go_deeper is refused with NOT_OFFERED. The tool's own tagged-but-not-offered path is the builder's unit test (ask-go-deeper.test.mjs).
